pageProps.title: God's Quiz Season 2 (2011)
pageProps.review: The mystery crime drama God's Quiz Season 2 perfectly inherits the characters from Season 1, vividly depicting a more solid plot and the expanded worldview of the protagonist Han Jin-woo with an immersive narrative.
pageProps.content:
## Review It seems that the characters established in Season 1 were well inherited without being disrupted. I felt that the scale and composition of the cases became even more solid.
It gradually expands the worldview of the character Han Jin-woo.
